summary: Rare's sci-fi espionage FPS series; use the Xbox 360/Rare Replay remaster for the N64 game, preserve the GBC prequel separately, and mark the canceled reboot honestly.

entries.title: Perfect Dark (Game Boy Color)

emulation.emulator: SameBoy / Gambatte or original Game Boy Color hardware
emulation.notes: Use accurate GBC emulation for preservation; original hardware is needed for full accessory behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Game Boy Color original, accurately emulated

primary.why: The Game Boy Color Perfect Dark is a direct prequel/supplement to the Nintendo 64 game, with built-in rumble, Game Link Cable multiplayer, Game Boy Printer support, and Transfer Pak unlocks for the N64 release. Game Boy Color is the only official platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Game Boy Color hardware or an accurate Game Boy Color emulator with owned media; use Transfer Pak with the N64 game only if preserving unlock behavior matters.

all_releases.fidelity: Only official handheld release, with built-in rumble and Game Boy accessory support.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one official platform release exists; Transfer Pak functionality is an accessory feature, not a separate version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; Transfer Pak-linked unlocks may not survive all digital/emulated contexts.
